from common import *
import yaml

def main():
 save_source(__file__)
 before=read(BASE/'docs/artifact-scope-before.json');state=read(PROGRESS);native=read(STATE)
 ps=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,command='],text=True)
 active=[]
 for line in ps.splitlines():
  parts=line.strip().split(None,2)
  if len(parts)<3:continue
  pid=int(parts[0]);cmd=parts[2]
  if str(TMP)+'/' in cmd and ('/python' in cmd or 'resource_tree.py' in cmd) and pid!=os.getpid():active.append(line)
 assert not active,active
 ml=ROOT/'mlruns';after=sorted(p.name for p in ml.iterdir() if p.is_dir())
 modified=[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in ml.rglob('meta.yaml') if p.stat().st_mtime>=native['started_at']]
 assert after==before['mlruns_directories'] and not modified
 actual=sorted(p.name for p in (ROOT/'backtest/result').iterdir() if p.is_dir())
 new=set(actual)-set(before['result_directories']);expected={j['session'] for j in state['jobs']}|{'20261107_pathsum_quantile10'}
 assert new==expected,(new,expected)
 assert not set(before['result_directories'])-set(actual)
 direct=[]
 for j in state['jobs']:
  root=ROOT/'backtest/result'/j['session'];assert root.is_dir()
  # save_session stores actual model bytes directly under this result session.
  receipt=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{j["job_id"]}.json');model=ROOT/receipt['model']['path']
  assert model.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()) and not model.is_symlink()
  direct.append({'session':j['session'],'model':receipt['model']})
 audit={'at':time.time(),'task_processes_active':active,'mlflow_metadata_modified_since_campaign_start':modified,'mlruns_directories_before':before['mlruns_directories'],'mlruns_directories_after':after,
 'new_result_directories':sorted(new),'removed_prior_result_directories':[], 'actual_direct_model_storage':direct,
 'mlruns_decision':'No new MLflow directories and no MLflow meta.yaml modified since campaign start; all20 actual models are local result artifacts. No task-owned MLflow run to delete.'}
 write(BASE/'docs/process-and-mlflow-audit.json',audit)
 plan=read(BASE/'docs/result-cleanup-dry-run.json');assert not plan['errors'] and not plan['delete_result_dirs'] and not plan['delete_mlruns_dirs']
 keep={str(Path(p)) for p in plan['keep_result_dirs']}
 for n in expected:
  assert str(ROOT/'backtest/result'/n) in keep or str(Path('backtest/result')/n) in keep or n in keep,(n,list(keep)[:3])
 write(BASE/'docs/result-retention-review.json',{'at':time.time(),'plan':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/result-cleanup-dry-run.json'),'errors':0,'delete_result_count':0,'delete_mlruns_count':0,'task_sessions_retained':20,'task_prediction_bundle_retained':True,'warnings':plan['warnings'],'decision':'Formal platform dry-run proposes zero deletions. Retain all existing platform dependencies; no apply needed. Historical missing-source warnings are recorded without rebuilding or changing historical results. MLflow independently audited.'})
 samples=[json.loads(l) for l in (TMP/'process-tree-samples.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if l]
 train=[s for s in samples if str(s.get('stage','')).startswith('train-')]
 write(BASE/'docs/resource-summary.json',{'samples':len(samples),'training_samples':len(train),'sampled_training_max_summed_rss_GiB':max(s['sum_rss_KiB'] for s in train)/1024**2,'training_span_seconds':max(j['finished_at'] for j in state['jobs'])-min(j['started_at'] for j in state['jobs']),'sum_job_wall_seconds':sum(j['finished_at']-j['started_at'] for j in state['jobs']),'campaign_through_pipeline_seconds':state['pipeline_finished_at']-native['started_at'],'physical_memory_GiB':16,'limit':'Summed RSS may double-count shared pages and is sampled; system swap includes unrelated processes.'})
 print('Retention audited:21 new result directories retained, no deletion candidates, no MLflow changes, task processes stopped.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
